questions.question: Who first discovered that the Aramean camp had been abandoned?
options: The soldiers on the city wall
Four lepers at the city gate
questions.answer: Four lepers at the city gate

questions.question: What had the Arameans heard that made them flee?
options: The roar of a sudden storm
The loud blast of the watchman's trumpet
The sound of chariots and a great army
The shaking of a great earthquake
questions.answer: The sound of chariots and a great army

questions.question: Elisha had prophesied that food would become cheap and plentiful the next day.
Four men with _____ found the Aramean camp deserted and full of food.
The LORD had made the Arameans hear the sound of a great _____, so they fled.
